title: Investigation on the quality of life and patient-centered outcome measures of parents and children with polycystic kidney diseases
summary:
One of the study aims is to ask patients and parents of children affected by polycystic kidney disease about their top priority outcomes for clinical trials in this filed. This aims to involve patients and their caregivers more in the design of future clinical trials.

Secondly, the study aims to investigate the quality of life of affected pediatric patients and their caregivers using questionnaires, in order to validate these instruments for use in future clinical trials, or to suggest adaptations if necessary.

interventions.name:
struktured Interview
Quality of life quesionnaires:
- PedsQL 4.0 generic and ESRD module
- Strengths and Difficulties Questionnaire (SDQ)
- Ulmer Lebensqualitäts-Inventar für Eltern chronisch kranker Kinder (ULQIE)
- Impact on Family Scale (IFS)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Children and young adults between 0 and 25 years as well as their caregivers (over 18 years) who are able to understand the interview questions and filll out questionnaires.
Exclusion criteria:
lack of an interpreter when knowledge of German is insufficient to understand interview or questionnaire.
